title.en: Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m is the Electric 40 Concrete Pump cell under “Shaft Power in watts”

description.en: Electric 40 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m Aggregate 13 is 40 m / 120 m
description.zh: 向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW见 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。是 21 m³/h。说“低压40”会改变订单。

h1.en: Keep Electric 40 Concrete Pump under “Shaft Power in hp” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「轴 功率 在 hp」下保留向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 40 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m. Aggregate 13 is 40 m / 120 m. Saying “low pressure 40” changes the order. Do not buy the mixer by copying only 45 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW and 12–15 m³/h. Order it when the site can feed 45 kW and you can name which distance row you mean. 45 kW, the row, stone size, and /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ to /en/contact/. The electric mixer also prints a 45 kW main motor, but it adds a 14 kW mixer motor and a single 100 m / 300 m pair. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 40 as a 45 kW motor, output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m, aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, Kawasaki 112, frame 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. The section title “Shaft Power in watts” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。是 21 m³/h。说“低压40”会改变订单。不要只抄 45 kW 去买搅拌泵。细石是 120 m / 360 m。13 骨料是 40 m / 120 m。电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h。现场能供给 45 kW，并且你能点明距离行时，才订它。电动搅拌泵也印主电机 45 kW，但另外有搅拌电机 14 kW 和一组 100 m / 300 m。45 kW、行名、石子粒径，以及 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ ，发到 /zh/contact/。河北品锦机械（邢台）把电动40印成电机 45 kW、输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、细石 120 m / 360 m、13 骨料 40 m / 120 m、川崎 112、外形 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、2300 kg。节标题「轴 功率 在 瓦」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.zh: 轴 功率 在 瓦

body.en: Electric 40 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Shaft Power in watts”. Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m. Do not buy the mixer by copying only 45 kW. 45 kW, the row, stone size, and /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ to /en/contact/.
body.zh: 向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW不因标题「轴 功率 在 瓦」而改动。河北品锦机械（邢台）把电动40印成电机 45 kW、输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、细石 120 m / 360 m、13 骨料 40 m / 120 m、川崎 112、外形 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、2300 kg。不要只抄 45 kW 去买搅拌泵。45 kW、行名、石子粒径，以及 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ ，发到 /zh/contact/。是 21 m³/h。

heading.zh: 轴 功率 在 hp

body.en: This section is titled “Shaft Power in hp”. Electric 40 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Aggregate 13 is 40 m / 120 m. Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW and 12–15 m³/h. The electric mixer also prints a 45 kW main motor, but it adds a 14 kW mixer motor and a single 100 m / 300 m pair.
body.zh: 本节标题是「轴 功率 在 hp」。向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW下面这些格子仍是印出来的。13 骨料是 40 m / 120 m。电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h。电动搅拌泵也印主电机 45 kW，但另外有搅拌电机 14 kW 和一组 100 m / 300 m。

heading.zh: 标准 马力 额定值

body.en: Under “Standard Horsepower Ratings”, Electric 40 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Saying “low pressure 40” changes the order. Order it when the site can feed 45 kW and you can name which distance row you mean. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 40 as a 45 kW motor, output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m, aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, Kawasaki 112, frame 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/electrical-motor-horsepower-d_653.html.
body.zh: 在「标准 马力 额定值」下，向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW这一节只放已印出的格子。说“低压40”会改变订单。现场能供给 45 kW，并且你能点明距离行时，才订它。细石是 120 m / 360 m。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/electrical-motor-horsepower-d_653.html。

question.en: Does “Shaft Power in watts” replace Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m?
question.zh: 「轴 功率 在 瓦」会替换「是 21 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m remains the printed wording for Electric 40 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 21 m³/h。仍是向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Aggregate 13 is 40 m / 120 m belong on the Electric 40 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW这一行里，「说“低压40”会改变订单。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-40-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Shaft Power in hp” add to Electric 40 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「轴 功率 在 hp」给向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/electrical-motor-horsepower-d_653.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/electrical-motor-horsepower-d_653.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
